title: 德國埃姆舍河整治~Emscher River restoration
focus: 污水地下化與河川生態復育的先後依賴~Dependence of river restoration on separated sewer infrastructure
summary: 埃姆舍轉型先把污水從河道移入管網與處理系統，再改善河岸與棲地。學徒需檢查污水未分離時，單做景觀能否持續維持水質。~The Emscher transformation moves sewage from the river into sewers and treatment before restoring banks and habitat. Learners assess whether landscaping alone can sustain water quality without sewage separation.

units.title: 污水與雨水來源分類：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Sewage/stormwater source separation: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「污水與雨水來源分類」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at sewage/stormwater source separation.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「污水與雨水來源分類」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for sewage/stormwater source separation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「污水與雨水來源分類」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the sewage/stormwater source separation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 新污水幹管斷面：流速與通水斷面~New sewer-trunk section: Velocity and flow area
units.mechanism: 連續方程 Q=Av 將流量連到平均流速；局部收縮與阻塞提高流速及水頭損失。本單元在「新污水幹管斷面」觀察此因果關係。~Continuity Q=Av links discharge to mean velocity; local contraction and blockage increase velocity and head loss. Examine this relationship at new sewer-trunk section.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：流量 Q=0.9 m³/s、有效面積 A=0.6 m²。公式 v=Q/A；代入 0.9/0.6 = 1.5 m/s。適用邊界：均勻平均流；不能用平均流速判定局部沖刷或人員安全。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: flow Q=0.9 m³/s and clear area A=0.6 m². Formula v=Q/A; substitution 0.9/0.6 = 1.5 m/s. Boundary: Uniform mean flow; local scour or human safety cannot be inferred from mean velocity alone.
units.verify: 比較水位、流量與有效面積，再以斷面多點量測查偏流。在離線場景為「新污水幹管斷面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare level, flow and clear area, then inspect nonuniformity with multiple section measurements. Build an offline evidence table for new sewer-trunk section; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 只使用名目斷面會忽略攔污物或沉積造成的縮減。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Nominal area misses reductions caused by debris or sediment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 阻塞不會改變同一流量下的流速。~Blockage cannot change velocity at the same flow.
units.practice: 先點選「新污水幹管斷面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效面積減至0.45 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 m/s。與基準 1.5 m/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the new sewer-trunk section measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only clear area to0.45 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 m/s. Compare with baseline 1.5 m/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 河道與幹管不同邊界：重力輸送與粗糙度~River/sewer hydraulic boundaries: Gravity conveyance and roughness
units.mechanism: Manning 模型以水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度表示明渠平均輸送能力；加粗表面會降低同水位的流量。本單元在「河道與幹管不同邊界」觀察此因果關係。~The Manning model relates open-channel capacity to hydraulic radius, slope and roughness; greater roughness reduces discharge at the same depth. Examine this relationship at river/sewer hydraulic boundaries.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：A=4 m²、R=0.8 m、S=0.001、n=0.015。公式 Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2)；代入 (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s。適用邊界：穩定均勻明渠近似；滿管壓力、回水與跌水需另建模。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: A=4 m², R=0.8 m, S=0.001 and n=0.015. Formula Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2); substitution (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s. Boundary: Steady uniform open-channel approximation; pressure flow, backwater and drops require separate models.
units.verify: 量測縱坡與斷面，校準不同水位的流量曲線。在離線場景為「河道與幹管不同邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure slope and section and calibrate the discharge curve at several depths. Build an offline evidence table for river/sewer hydraulic boundaries; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 沉積與生物膜改變粗糙度，沿用初建值可能高估能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Sediment and biofilm alter roughness; an as-built value may overestimate capacity. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 同一斷面輸送能力與粗糙度無關。~Capacity of the same section is independent of roughness.
units.practice: 先點選「河道與幹管不同邊界」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把 n 改成0.020，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 5.450337 m³/s。與基準 7.267115 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the river/sewer hydraulic boundaries measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only n to0.020 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 5.450337 m³/s. Compare with baseline 7.267115 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 低地提升系統：提升水頭與電力~Lowland lift system: Lift head and electrical power
units.mechanism: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「低地提升系統」觀察此因果關係。~Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at lowland lift system.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「低地提升系統」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for lowland lift system; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 相同流量下所有泵的耗電都相同。~All pumps consume the same power at equal flow.
units.practice: 先點選「低地提升系統」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the lowland lift system measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 處理廠與河道質量帳：去除效率與質量去向~Treatment/river mass ledger: Removal efficiency and mass destination
units.mechanism: 去除是污染物由水相移到污泥或被轉化；以相同流量比較濃度可估效率，但不能省略副產物流。本單元在「處理廠與河道質量帳」觀察此因果關係。~Removal moves pollutants from water to solids or transforms them; concentration comparison estimates efficiency at equal flows but does not eliminate residual streams. Examine this relationship at treatment/river mass ledger.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Cin=200 mg/L、Cout=40 mg/L且進出水量相同。公式 η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin；代入 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %。適用邊界：只適用同一物種、同時窗且等流量；不能代替總污染收支。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Cin=200 mg/L and Cout=40 mg/L at equal inlet and outlet flows. Formula η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin; substitution 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %. Boundary: Same species, time window and flow only; not a replacement for a complete pollutant balance.
units.verify: 同時量測污泥固體量與水相濃度，對照移除質量。在離線場景為「處理廠與河道質量帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure sludge solids and water concentrations together to reconcile removed mass. Build an offline evidence table for treatment/river mass ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以清水稀釋取代處理會讓濃度變低但不一定減少排放質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Dilution can lower concentration without lowering discharge mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 看不到的污染物代表已完全被破壞。~An invisible pollutant has been completely destroyed.
units.practice: 先點選「處理廠與河道質量帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水改成60 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 70 %。與基準 80 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the treatment/river mass ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effluent to60 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 70 %. Compare with baseline 80 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 雨天面源逕流：集水面積與逕流量~Wet-weather diffuse runoff: Catchment area and runoff volume
units.mechanism: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「雨天面源逕流」觀察此因果關係。~Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at wet-weather diffuse runoff.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
units.verify: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「雨天面源逕流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for wet-weather diffuse runoff; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 總雨量相同就保證尖峰淹水風險相同。~Equal storm totals guarantee equal peak flood risk.
units.practice: 先點選「雨天面源逕流」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the wet-weather diffuse runoff measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 恢復河岸沖蝕：河床剪應力與岸坡材料~Restored-bank shear: Bed shear and bank materials
units.mechanism: 均勻流平均剪應力約為ρgRS；植被與岸坡材料的抗蝕能力應與局部流況一起檢核。本單元在「恢復河岸沖蝕」觀察此因果關係。~Mean boundary shear in uniform flow is aboutρgRS; erosion resistance of vegetation and banks needs checking against local hydraulics. Examine this relationship at restored-bank shear.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：ρ=1000 kg/m³、R=0.6 m、S=0.001。公式 τ=ρgRS；代入 1000*9.81*0.6*0.001 = 5.886 Pa。適用邊界：斷面平均值，不含彎道、橋墩與局部湍流尖峰。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: ρ=1000 kg/m³, R=0.6 m andS=0.001. Formula τ=ρgRS; substitution 1000*9.81*0.6*0.001 = 5.886 Pa. Boundary: Section mean; bends, piers and local turbulence peaks excluded.
units.verify: 比較洪後沖淤剖面與植被存活，不只採用一張乾季照片。在離線場景為「恢復河岸沖蝕」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare post-flood erosion profiles and plant survival rather than one dry-season photograph. Build an offline evidence table for restored-bank shear; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 彎道外側局部沖刷可遠高於平均值。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Outer-bend local scour can greatly exceed the mean. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 全段平均剪應力低就證明每處河岸都不會侵蝕。~Low reach-average shear proves that no bank location can erode.
units.practice: 先點選「恢復河岸沖蝕」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把S增加到0.002，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 11.772 Pa。與基準 5.886 Pa比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the restored-bank shear measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only S to0.002 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 11.772 Pa. Compare with baseline 5.886 Pa and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 河川廊道連接：生態廊道與可用棲地~River-corridor linkage: Ecological corridors and usable habitat
units.mechanism: 綠地面積與真正連通的可用棲地不同；硬質障礙、照明與維護方式影響動植物通行。本單元在「河川廊道連接」觀察此因果關係。~Green area differs from connected usable habitat; hard barriers, lighting and maintenance affect movement. Examine this relationship at river-corridor linkage.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：廊道長800 m、平均有效寬度12 m。公式 A=Lw；代入 800*12 = 9600 m²。適用邊界：幾何面積近似，不是物種存活率或生態服務價值。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: corridor length800 m and mean effective width12 m. Formula A=Lw; substitution 800*12 = 9600 m². Boundary: Geometric-area approximation, not survival probability or ecosystem-service valuation.
units.verify: 在地圖標斷點，搭配定點觀察確認指定物種是否實際使用。在離線場景為「河川廊道連接」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Map breaks and use fixed observations to verify use by specified species. Build an offline evidence table for river-corridor linkage; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 廊道被道路切斷時，相同面積仍可能失去連通。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A road break can destroy connectivity despite unchanged area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要綠地面積增加，所有物種都會受益。~More green area benefits every species.
units.practice: 先點選「河川廊道連接」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效寬度減成8 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6400 m²。與基準 9600 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the river-corridor linkage measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only effective width to8 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6400 m². Compare with baseline 9600 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 底棲與岸帶調查：棲地樣區與多樣性指標~Benthic/riparian surveys: Habitat plots and diversity indicators
units.mechanism: Simpson多樣性以物種比例衡量優勢程度；指標增加不等於所有原生物種都恢復。本單元在「底棲與岸帶調查」觀察此因果關係。~Simpson diversity measures dominance through species proportions; a larger index does not prove recovery of every native species. Examine this relationship at benthic/riparian surveys.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：四類生物比例0.4、0.3、0.2、0.1。公式 D=1-Σpi²；代入 1-(0.4**2+0.3**2+0.2**2+0.1**2) = 0.7 index。適用邊界：相同採樣方法與努力量；不替代保育物種與外來種調查。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: four taxon proportions0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1. Formula D=1-Σpi²; substitution 1-(0.4**2+0.3**2+0.2**2+0.1**2) = 0.7 index. Boundary: Same sampling method and effort; not a replacement for protected- and invasive-species surveys.
units.verify: 固定樣區、季節與採樣時長，另記棲地連續性與外來種。在離線場景為「底棲與岸帶調查」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Fix plots, season and effort and separately record connectivity and invasive species. Build an offline evidence table for benthic/riparian surveys; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 採樣努力量增加會製造看似改善，須對照基線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Greater sampling effort can mimic improvement; compare with the baseline. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 看到更多物種就可以忽略是否為入侵物種。~More observed species makes invasive status irrelevant.
units.practice: 先點選「底棲與岸帶調查」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把分布改成四類各0.25，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.75 index。與基準 0.7 index比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the benthic/riparian surveys measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only proportions to four equal0.25 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.75 index. Compare with baseline 0.7 index and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 流域修復成效歸因：前後與對照地點比較~Basin-restoration attribution: Before-after and control comparison
units.mechanism: 干預前後差異還可能包含天氣與背景趨勢；前後—對照差分可分離共同變化但仍須檢查可比性。本單元在「流域修復成效歸因」觀察此因果關係。~Before-after changes include weather and background trends; difference-in-differences removes common changes but still needs comparable sites. Examine this relationship at basin-restoration attribution.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：處理地由30降至27，對照地由29降至28，同一指標。公式 effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore)；代入 (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit。適用邊界：假設共同背景趨勢；不是隨機試驗或完全因果證明。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: treated site30 to27 and control site29 to28 for the same indicator. Formula effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore); substitution (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit. Boundary: Common background trend assumed; not a randomized trial or complete causal proof.
units.verify: 採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「流域修復成效歸因」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for basin-restoration attribution; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 前後改變全都必定由這一項工程造成。~Every before-after change must be caused by this project.
units.practice: 先點選「流域修復成效歸因」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把對照地事後值改成27，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 -1 indicator unit。與基準 -2 indicator unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the basin-restoration attribution measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only control-after to27 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute -1 indicator unit. Compare with baseline -2 indicator unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

sources.title: 埃姆舍協會與污水幹管

history: Emschergenossenschaft介紹埃姆舍流域以污水幹管、處理廠及河川重整共同完成轉型，強調流域尺度工程的相互依賴。~Emschergenossenschaft describes basin transformation through sewers, treatment plants and river restructuring, emphasizing interdependent infrastructure.

單元1變量實驗：只把流量改成1500 m³/d~Unit1 changed-input experiment: change only flow to1500 m³/d

單元2變量實驗：只把有效面積減至0.45 m²~Unit2 changed-input experiment: reduce only clear area to0.45 m²
單元3基準：河道與幹管不同邊界~Unit3 baseline: river/sewer hydraulic boundaries
單元3變量實驗：只把 n 改成0.020~Unit3 changed-input experiment: change only n to0.020
單元4基準：低地提升系統~Unit4 baseline: lowland lift system
單元4變量實驗：只把效率降成0.60~Unit4 changed-input experiment: reduce only efficiency to0.60
單元5基準：處理廠與河道質量帳~Unit5 baseline: treatment/river mass ledger
單元5變量實驗：只把出水改成60 mg/L~Unit5 changed-input experiment: change only effluent to60 mg/L
單元6基準：雨天面源逕流~Unit6 baseline: wet-weather diffuse runoff
單元6變量實驗：只把C降成0.50~Unit6 changed-input experiment: reduce only C to0.50
單元7基準：恢復河岸沖蝕~Unit7 baseline: restored-bank shear
單元7變量實驗：只把S增加到0.002~Unit7 changed-input experiment: increase only S to0.002
單元8基準：河川廊道連接~Unit8 baseline: river-corridor linkage
單元8變量實驗：只把有效寬度減成8 m~Unit8 changed-input experiment: reduce only effective width to8 m
單元9基準：底棲與岸帶調查~Unit9 baseline: benthic/riparian surveys
單元9變量實驗：只把分布改成四類各0.25~Unit9 changed-input experiment: change only proportions to four equal0.25
單元10基準：流域修復成效歸因~Unit10 baseline: basin-restoration attribution
